Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 14:30

Please let me know which of these work for them.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked the calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor. Of the times you provided, the only one that works for them is Thursday at 14:30. Please go ahead and book the meeting for that time.

workspace.text: Hi Brad. The meeting has been booked for Thursday at 14:30. It's now over to you to send the confirmation email to the partners. Thanks!
